offering_description.value: Operates bowling and entertainment centers, formerly branded Bowlero, that rent lanes and arcade play to families, groups and leagues. Revenue comes from lane play, food and drink, and hosted parties and events at its own venues.

primary_products.value: food and beverage; alcoholic drinks; arcade games; bowling merchandise

primary_services.value: bowling lane rental; party and event hosting; league bowling programs; corporate event hosting

customer_segment.value: B2C: families, friends, birthday parties, casual groups and recreational bowlers; B2B: corporate event planners, company holiday parties and team outings

end_markets.value: consumer entertainment; food and beverage service; corporate events; recreational sports leagues

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: customers pay per game, lane time and arcade play; product sales: food, drinks and merchandise sold at the centers; service fees: party packages, event hosting and league fees
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs bowling centers with lanes, arcades and kitchens; service provider: sells lane time, hosted parties and events directly to consumers and businesses

geography_served.value: North America: centers across most US states, with a few locations in Canada

specialization.value: niche specialist: bowling and entertainment centers, with food, drink, arcade and party offerings inside them

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated bowling and entertainment centers; online: website and app booking of lanes, parties and events

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state and local liquor licensing, food safety and health codes, and building and safety rules at its centers

notes: The company was formerly known as Bowlero, and its exact center count and location mix may have changed.
